E37.statement: The declared critical/cycle support, q0 interval, paired-arc falsifier, conjugate interval, and finite resonance rows are independently reproducible.

H147.statement: Control all near-resonant Type-C profiles and the collapsed Type-A/B families, then address arbitrary area and noncoprime slopes.

NG34.statement: Every valid critical Type-C area-three profile satisfies one of the two Phase-24 arc thresholds.

P151.statement: Changing H bits adds at most nH linear or cyclic length-n factors; critical and cycle profile supports therefore give the stated support-sensitive linear bounds.

P152.statement: Under P54 and pairwise-distinct critical states, q<=(2n_q+1)s+2n_q+2. Under EXT04 the q0 width is exactly 73 and the support lower bound is 490186612.

P153.statement: Each positive critical defect loses more than 1/4 normalized correction, hence s<4(S0-3N delta) under P54.

P154.statement: An integral coprime resonant-grid profile forces a nonzero resultant divisible by D, with an exact conjugate-product magnitude bound.

P155.statement: The critical coprime seven-grid area-three family with roots Q,2Q,3Q is impossible; Q>=11 uses EXT05 and smaller coprime Q are direct.

q0_certificate.boundary: The lower support bound additionally assumes P54 and pairwise-distinct critical states. The upper support bound assumes P54 and X02. The S0 enclosure uses EXT04.

cycle_area_three.conditional_consequence: If n_cyc<=h+O(log q), then s=Omega(sqrt(q)); the polynomial cycle-minimum premise is not proved.

resonance_boundary: P154/P155 require gcd(q,L)=1. EXT05 is an external theorem. Near-resonant and noncoprime profiles remain open.
what_this_result_does_not_prove: It does not prove H89, H133, H147, H72, or the Collatz conjecture.
